text: Kiewit is an employee-owned construction and engineering organization operating through a network of subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Guam.
short: Kiewit is an employee-owned construction and engineering organization.

source.name: Colorado Rapids: 'Colorado Rapids announce Kiewit as official jersey sleeve partner' (About Kiewit Corporation section)
source.quote: With its roots dating back to 1884, the employee-owned organization operates through a network of subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Guam.
source.note: The page itself carries no dateline; the club's announcement posts on Facebook and X and the Denver Business Journal dateline both show 4 July 2025.
